origin.match: Match each fruit to the place it first grew.
origin.odd: Three of these fruits first grew in {value}. Which one didn't?
origin.all: Tap all {n} fruits that first grew in {value}.

rows.label: Apple
rows.description: edible fruit of the apple tree
rows.hook: is the crunchy orchard staple said to keep the doctor away, and a famous symbol of temptation

rows.label: Persimmon
rows.description: edible fruit of a number of species of trees in the genus Diospyros
rows.hook: is a glossy, bright orange autumn treat eaten soft and sweet, or dried

rows.label: Dragon fruit
rows.hook: is a hot-pink exotic cactus produce with white, black-speckled flesh, also called pitaya

rows.label: Mangosteen
rows.hook: is a purple-rinded tropical treat with snowy segments, nicknamed the queen of tropical produce

rows.label: Durian
rows.description: fruit of several tree species belonging to the genus Durio
rows.hook: is a spiky giant nicknamed the king of fruits, famous for a smell so strong that hotels ban it

rows.label: Pomegranate
rows.hook: is a leathery red globe packed with juicy ruby seeds, long a symbol of abundance

rows.label: Lychee
rows.hook: is a small tropical treat with a rough red shell and sweet, translucent white flesh around a big seed

rows.label: Tamarind
rows.hook: is a brown pod with sticky, tangy pulp, used in chutneys, sauces and sweet-sour drinks

rows.label: Orange
rows.description: citrus fruit of the orange tree
rows.hook: is the juicy citrus that is squeezed for breakfast juice and gives its name to a color

rows.label: Pineapple
rows.hook: is a spiky-crowned tropical treat, famous for sweet yellow slices that are controversial on pizza

rows.label: Pomelo
rows.hook: is the largest citrus, with thick pith and mild sweet flesh, and is an ancestor of the grapefruit

rows.label: Jackfruit
rows.hook: is a gigantic spiky tropical tree produce whose stringy flesh is used as a meat substitute in vegan cooking

rows.label: Kiwi
rows.description: edible berry of woody vines in the genus Actinidia
rows.hook: is a fuzzy brown-skinned berry with bright green flesh and tiny black seeds, nicknamed the Chinese gooseberry

rows.label: Mango
rows.hook: is a juicy stone fruit with golden flesh, often called the king of fruits in South Asia and made into lassi

rows.label: Watermelon
rows.hook: is a big green-striped summer picnic favorite with sweet red flesh, spat seeds and mostly water

rows.label: Rambutan
rows.hook: is a tropical treat with a hairy red shell that peels back to reveal sweet, translucent white flesh

rows.label: Blueberry
rows.hook: is a small, round, dusty-blue berry beloved in muffins and pancakes, and packed with antioxidants

rows.label: Peach
rows.description: species of fruit tree (for the fruit use Q13202263)
rows.hook: is a fuzzy-skinned summer stone fruit with sweet juicy flesh, loved in cobbler and pie, and a Georgia icon

rows.label: Kumquat
rows.description: common name for a group of citrus trees that produce cumquat fruit
rows.hook: is a tiny citrus that is eaten whole, rind and all, with a sweet skin and a sour center

rows.label: Papaya
rows.hook: is a tropical treat with soft orange flesh and a cavity of black seeds, whose enzyme tenderizes meat

rows.label: Grapefruit
rows.hook: is a tart, bitter-sweet breakfast citrus with pink or yellow segments, traditionally eaten with a spoon

rows.label: Mandarin orange
rows.hook: is a small, loose-skinned citrus that peels easily, associated with Lunar New Year gifts and canned segments

rows.label: Starfruit
rows.hook: is a waxy yellow-green tropical treat that makes a five-pointed shape when sliced across
